blocks.source: Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS®, MLS® Home Price Index, September 2026 (released October 2, 2026). The benchmark is the board’s modelled price for a typical home of this type, not an average of sales. The index sets January 2005 at 100. Changes are as published; the text below calls a change a rise or fall only at 1.5% or more.

blocks.text: Port Coquitlam: the townhomes benchmark was $834,300 in September 2026. Over the past year it fell 7.8%; over three months it fell 4.9%; over the last month it fell 1.5%. Longer term, over 3 years it fell 11.1%; over 5 years it rose 2.0%; over 10 years it rose 57.2%.
Townhomes against other home types in Port Coquitlam

Port Coquitlam: the townhomes benchmark of $834,300 sits $406,300 below the detached houses benchmark of $1,240,600 (67% of it) and $284,300 above the apartments (condos) benchmark of $550,000 (152% of it).
Elementary and middle schools in Port Coquitlam

It is not a catchment list: which school serves a home is set by address, so check the exact address with the school district.

items.t: Port Coquitlam real estate market stats

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a townhome in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for townhomes in Port Coquitlam was $834,300 in September 2026, a modelled price for a typical home and not an average of sales.

faq.q: Did townhome prices fall in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: Over the past year the benchmark fell 7.8%. Over three months it fell 4.9%. A change under 1.5% is not described as a rise or fall.

faq.q: Is Port Coquitlam a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in Port Coquitlam had a sales ratio of 17%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market, and condos and townhomes 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many townhomes are for sale in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the townhomes in Port Coquitlam that match what you want.

faq.q: Can Jared alert me when townhomes come up in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: Yes. Tell him the area, price range and must-haves and he will alert you the day a match is listed.

faq.q: Where can I see all Port Coquitlam homes?
faq.a: The Port Coquitlam homes for sale page covers every home type, and the Port Coquitlam market stats page has the monthly figures.
